newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE's new Emaar Properties raises IPO amount.
newsitem.headline: UAE's new Emaar Properties raises IPO amount.

text.p: Newly formed United Arab Emirates real estate firm Emaar Properties has raised the amount of its initial public offering by 85 percent to one billion dirhams, UAE newspapers said on Monday.

"Sheikh Maktoum bin Rashid Al Maktoum (ruler of Dubai and UAE prime minister) instructed the company to raise its capital to one billion dirhams from 540 million dirhams," the English language Gulf News said.
Papers said the Dubai government would take an equity holding in Emaar, but it was yet not clear how much.
Brokers told Reuters they expected the Dubai government to have a 10 percent stake in Emaar.
Emaar said last month it would offer 29.7 million shares at 10 dirhams each to UAE nationals from April 2 to April 14. Seventy nine founder shareholders committed 243 million dirhams.
The subscription period has been extended by a day to April 15, the newspapers said.
